title: How a stolen token is replayed
lede: The mock authorization server issues a token to the agent. A thief captures it and replays it at the mock gateway, which forwards to an API only if every defence you left on agrees. Everything is simulated.

nodes.label: Mock authorization server
sub: Issues the access token (bearer, DPoP or mTLS-bound).

nodes.label: Agent
sub: The legitimate holder of the token (and the key).

nodes.label: Mock gateway
sub: Runs the defences you switched on.

nodes.label: {{api_a}}
sub: The API the token was issued for.

steps.title: Token issued
steps.what: The mock authorization server mints a labelled mock token for the agent.

steps.title: Token captured
steps.what: A thief copies the token (and, in the hard scenarios, a proof, the key or the certificate).

steps.title: Legitimate call
steps.what: The agent calls the gateway the way it should.

steps.title: Replay
steps.what: The thief replays what it stole. The defences you left on decide the answer.

steps.title: Forwarded or stopped
steps.what: A replay that passes every check reaches an API; one that does not is refused at the gateway.
